title: Too heavy, too rough, unappealing
text:
Too heavy, too rough, unappealing. Well, this is one of those items you will either hate or love - unlikely you will be on the fence.

The colors are lovely and neutral enough to use in almost any decor. However, this is NOT one of those super soft throws. This one is very heavy, a little awkward, and I found the texture very unappealing. Mine also came with a big ol' snag in it already.

If you've ever used those cotton basic blankets, like hospitals often use, you'll have a good idea of how this feels, except hospital blankets are softer.

The plaid is nice, the colors are good. But the texture and weight is a real turn-off to me. I can't recommend this one.
